resources.string:
This app shows the Job Aggregator running on your own computer. On that computer, start it in LAN mode:

 python -m aggregator serve --lan

It prints the server address and access token to type in below (also shown at http://localhost:8765/phone on the computer).
Access token (if the server shows one)
Enter the computer\'s address, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8765
No app on this phone can open that link.

Check that:
• the phone is on the same Wi-Fi as the computer (not mobile data or a guest network)
• the computer is on and awake
• the server is running in LAN mode: python -m aggregator serve --lan
• the computer's firewall allows incoming TCP port 8765 (private/home network)
• the address is the computer's IP, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8765
